records.jp: それじゃあ、オーディションを始めます
records.en_original: We will now commence the audition.
records.en_auxiliary: We will now commence the audition.
records.en: All right, we'll begin the audition.

records.jp: 今回の候補者は２名。<CR>白井日菜子さんと蜷川麻央さん
records.en_original: We have two actresses in the running today: Hinako Shirai and Mao Ninagawa.
records.en_auxiliary: We have two actresses in the running today: Hinako Shirai and Mao Ninagawa.
records.en: We have two candidates:<CR>Shirai Hinako-san and Ninagawa Mao-san.

records.jp: まずは白井さんからお願いします
records.en_original: Shirai, if you please.
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai, if you please.

records.jp: はい
records.en_original: Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、頑張って
records.en_original: Good luck, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Good luck, Hina!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、しっかりね
records.en_original: Stay calm, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Stay calm, Hina.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Got it.
records.en_auxiliary: Got it.

records.jp: 王子、あなたは私を選んでくれなかった。<CR>だから私はもうすぐ魔法の代償で海の泡になってしまう
records.en_original: Alas, dear Prince, I was not your chosen beloved. My wish unfulfilled, I will soon be naught but seafoam.
records.en_auxiliary: Alas, dear Prince, I was not your chosen beloved. My wish unfulfilled, I will soon be naught but sea foam.
records.en: Prince, you didn't choose me.<CR>So soon, as the price of magic, I'll become seafoam.

records.jp: それを避けるには、このナイフであなたの心臓を刺すしかない。<CR>思い人の血を私の足に塗りつけるしか
records.en_original: The only way to escape this fate is to pierce your heart with my dagger and stain my legs with your blood.
records.en_auxiliary: The only way to escape this fate is to pierce your heart with my dagger and smear my legs with your blood.
records.en: The only way to escape this fate is to pierce your heart with this dagger<CR>and stain my legs with the blood of the one I love.

records.jp: あなたが……私を選んでくれなかったから！
records.en_original: If only...you had chosen me!
records.en_auxiliary: All because you chose someone other than me!

records.jp: だめ……できない
records.en_original: No... I cannot.
records.en_auxiliary: No... I cannot.

records.jp: 王子が誰のものになったとしても、私の思いは変わらない
records.en_original: It matters not that you belong to someone else. The place you hold in my heart is unchanging.
records.en_auxiliary: It matters not that you belong to someone else. The place you hold in my heart is unchanged.
records.en: No matter whose you become, my feelings will never change.

records.jp: 私は自分の思いを殺せない
records.en_original: I cannot kill my feelings.
records.en_auxiliary: I cannot kill my feelings.

records.jp: さようなら、愛しい人。<CR>私は泡となって、すべての恋人たちを見守り続けましょう
records.en_original: Goodbye, my dearest. Would that I, as seafoam, watch over all the lovers of this world now and forever more.
records.en_auxiliary: Goodbye, my dearest. Would that I, as sea foam, watch over all the lovers of this world now and forever more.
records.en: Farewell, my love.<CR>I shall become seafoam and watch over all lovers forever.

records.jp: すごい……
records.en_original: Wow...
records.en_auxiliary: Wow...

records.jp: なんか、本当に王子様がいるみたい……
records.en_original: It feels like she really has her own prince...
records.en_auxiliary: It feels like she really has her own prince...
records.en: It's like there's really a prince standing there...

records.jp: じゃあ次は蜷川さん
records.en_original: Now then. When you're ready, Ninagawa.
records.en_auxiliary: Now then. When you're ready, Ninagawa.

records.jp: ……ふん
records.en_original: ...Hmph.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hmph.

records.jp: あんな偉そうな態度で人魚姫の演技なんてできるのかな
records.en_original: With an attitude like that, I have to wonder if she'd be a good fit for the Little Mermaid...
records.en_auxiliary: With an attitude like that, I have to wonder if she'd be a good fit for the Little Mermaid...
records.en: With that attitude, can she really play the Little Mermaid?

records.jp: ……魔女のおばあさんの方が向いてそうだよね
records.en_original: ...I think she'd make a good witch.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I think she'd make a good witch.
records.en: ...She seems more suited to the old witch.

records.jp: しっ。始まるよ
records.en_original: Shh. It's starting.
records.en_auxiliary: Shh. It's starting.

records.en_original: Is something wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Is something wrong?

records.en_auxiliary: Ninagawa...?
